Interface TenantResolver

public interface TenantResolver
Resolves the data tenant for the current request scope.

This is the frozen SPI the commercial multi-tenant edition of kumbuka depends on. The OSS edition ships

invalid reference 
DefaultSingleTenantResolver
, which always returns the configured singleton tenant. The commercial edition replaces this bean by registering its own @ApplicationScoped TenantResolver — Quarkus picks the non-default bean automatically (see ADR-0011).

Contract

  • Returns the current data tenant id. Never null. A missing tenant context is a programming error and the implementation should throw rather than guess.
  • Stable across the lifetime of a single request transaction. The wiring guarantees the resolver is called once per transaction boundary; implementations should not memoize beyond that.
  • Idempotent and free of side effects. The framework may invoke this method from a Flyway callback, from an interceptor, and from the Hibernate session-current-tenant lookup, all within the same transaction.

Effective tenant. Application code never reads this resolver directly. Both the Hibernate CurrentTenantIdentifierResolver and the Postgres session-GUC setter go through TenantContext.current(), which returns the value bound via TenantContext.bind(UUID) when present and delegates to this resolver otherwise. That single read point prevents a split brain between Hibernate and the Postgres GUC.
